climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A Croatian appellation for still, sparkling, semi-sparkling and liqueur wine, with communes such as Krk, Cres, Opatija and Novi Vinodolski. Its grapes include Malvazija Istarska, Žlahtina, Teran, Babić and Plavac Mali Crni, as well as Chardonnay and Merlot.
